description: WinMax UI as a finite state machine: screens=states, softkeys/keys=transitions, fields=per-state data. Built by scripts/winmax-ui-map.mjs to give the autonomous post-test harness deterministic, vision-free navigation (whereami + BFS path). Headers are GRAPHICAL (0 UIA Text nodes), so screens are fingerprinted by their probe signature (Edit field-id set minus StatusBar.* + List/ListItem presence); field-less menu screens are disambiguated by their softkey labels (vision, recorded once). slot:echo.

ISNC_EDITOR.name: ISNC Program Editor
ISNC_EDITOR.header: (G-code text editor; loaded program shows here)
ISNC_EDITOR.notes: A docked Find/Search bar sits at the bottom. The loaded program buffer can be clobbered by a stray ^a+type — disk file is the source of truth.

TAGGED_BLOCKS.name: Tagged Blocks (editor sub-screen)
TAGGED_BLOCKS.notes: Editor sub-menu. F8 EXIT returns to ISNC_EDITOR.

INPUT_MENU.name: Input / Program top menu
INPUT_MENU.notes: Status line reads 'Select a softkey.' Reached from ISNC_EDITOR via F8 EXIT EDITOR.

PART_SETUP.name: Part Setup
PART_SETUP.notes: F1 WORK OFFSETS = set G54 part-zero. F2 TOOL SETUP = per-program tool form.

TOOL_SETUP_FORM.name: Tool Setup (per-program tool form)
TOOL_SETUP_FORM.blocker: TOOL TYPE + COOLANT are non-UIA icon-font dropdowns (not text-addressable; selectable as List/ListItem when expanded but item names are private-use glyphs). NOT a verify blocker though — undefined tools render as unknown/dia-0 and do NOT block Draw (User Guide p99). Drive by UIA SelectionItem on the expanded List, or click-xy on the arrow.
TOOL_SETUP_FORM.notes: Per-program tool reference form (TOOL NUMBER/TYPE/DIAMETER/SPEED/COOLANT/CAL LENGTH). TOOL TYPE + COOLANT are non-UIA dropdowns. Entering a diameter + ENTER jumps to TOOL_DATABASE (transition trigger to re-confirm).

TOOL_DATABASE.name: Tool and Material Database
TOOL_DATABASE.notes: THE place tools are DEFINED (clears 'TOOL n NOT DEFINED'). F1 ADD TOOL -> ADD_TOOL_FORM. List/ListItem signature distinguishes it from menu screens.

ADD_TOOL_FORM.name: Tool Type Setup (add-tool form)
ADD_TOOL_FORM.solved: TOOL TYPE dropdown (non-UIA) is driven by click-xy: click the arrow (~598,179 winRel) to open, click the item row to select. PROVEN. GEOMETRY fields then appear (CUTTING DIAMETER=303, OUTER DIA CAL=311, LENGTH OF CUT CAL=314, TOOL LENGTH CAL=315, ANGLE=318, CUTTING EDGES=324, RADIUS=325).
ADD_TOOL_FORM.fieldCommitRule: Commit geometry fields with {TAB}, NOT {ENTER} — {ENTER} = save+exit and fires before the value commits (typed dia 2.0 saved as 0.0000). type-into appends {ENTER} so it is WRONG here; use click-xy + sendkeys ^a + value{TAB}.
ADD_TOOL_FORM.notes: Softkeys ARE the tabs (F1 GEOMETRY .. F5 NOTES). EDIT/DELETE TOOL are greyed until a list row is click-xy-selected.

TOOL_OFFSETS.name: Tool Offsets table
TOOL_OFFSETS.reachedBy: TOOL_SETUP_FORM {F4} (the per-program tool form's F4 = TOOL OFFSETS softkey). Vision-free discovered 2026-05-31 via Edit-id signature diff.
TOOL_OFFSETS.notes: Dense contiguous Edit grid (300-347 = ~48 table cells) — the H/D length+diameter+wear offset registers consumed by the NC's G43 H1..H4. Per-cell semantic map (which cell = H1 length vs D diameter vs wear) is a sub-gap: needs a value-read calibration pass (set a known offset, read which id changed). High-confidence TOOL OFFSETS but headers are graphical so unverified by text.

DRAW_VERIFY.name: Graphics / Draw / Verify (program simulation view)
DRAW_VERIFY.header: (graphical sim viewport; 0 UIA Text/Edit nodes — field-less)
DRAW_VERIFY.buttonsSource: LIVE-CAPTURED 2026-06-01 (Max5UI pid87672, WinMax Mill 10.4; --op probe, 153 nodes). The Draw/Verify console controls are plain UIA Buttons with stable automationIds — NOT a vision touch-point (corrects the prior 'Draw needs vision' assumption, see WINMAX-LIVE-TEST-LOG.md).
DRAW_VERIFY.notes: Field-less (empty Edit-signature) so it collides with the menu screens under the Edit-only signature — resolved by the ADDITIVE distinctive-Button tiebreak (U-WINMAX-BUTTON-SIGNATURE): matchScreen falls back to disambiguateByButtons, which Jaccard-overlaps this stored set against the live Button automationIds. DrawButton/SingleStepButton/NextToolChangeButton/PauseButton are directly UIA-clickable → read-only verify-program courses + the Draw trigger become unattended clicks (no vision).
